dossier.style: Static dominance and destructive energy projection. Trigon uses six eyes for multi-directional hellfire blasts and the brutal strength of a deity to effortlessly shatter and repel any opponent.
dossier.advantage: Heart of Darkness and dark immortality. The condensed evil of a hundred galaxies gives him almost infinite magic resources and the ability to instantly regenerate from the very essence of darkness.
dossier.mentality: Sadistic tyrant seeking total conquest. Does not seek a challenge, but revels in the despair and slow breaking of the opponent's spirit before their ultimate annihilation.
dossier.quote: In seeking to eradicate my evil... You have made me supreme! I am now power. I am now death. I am now TRIGON!

powers: Demonic energy projection, corruption, possession, regeneration, dimensional travel.
weaknesses: Peak control is strongest inside favorable demonic environments.
Broad cosmic resistance can slow his corruption tempo in neutral space.

dossier.style: Direct dominance of the Power Cosmic. Galactus strikes with devastating energy blasts, immobilizes enemies with telekinesis, and uses molecular restructuring to turn opponents into pure energy with a single gesture.
dossier.advantage: Absolute power absorption and the Ultimate Nullifier. Can absorb energy directed against him (even from deities), and if necessary, use the Nullifier to erase entire galaxies or timelines from existence.
dossier.mentality: Detached, eternally hungry force of nature. Feels no anger or hatred – perceives heroes and deities like insects or fuel, acting entirely outside the categories of good and evil.
dossier.quote: Of all the creatures in the vastness of the universe, there is none like me. I was present at the birth of the universe, and I shall be there at its end.

powers: Power Cosmic, transmutation, large-scale energy projection, barriers, and matter control.
weaknesses: In low-fed states, response speed and margin for error decrease.

parameter-comparison.subtitle: Average stat profile map
parameter-comparison.headline: PARAMETER COMPARISON
parameter-comparison.left_summary: Trigon bends the field hardest when corruption starts replacing normal combat rules.
parameter-comparison.right_summary: Galactus owns the broader profile and the cleaner neutral-space answer set.
parameter-comparison.draw_summary: The fight tightens only when starvation and home-realm logic distort the map.

battle-dynamics.headline: BATTLE DYNAMICS
battle-dynamics.subtitle: How the fight changes minute by minute.
battle-dynamics.left_note: Trigon rises when the field behaves more like a demonic domain.
battle-dynamics.right_note: Galactus is strongest when space can be normalized and metabolized.

x-factor.headline: X-FACTOR
x-factor.subtitle: The variable that affects the verdict more than ordinary stats.
x-factor.left_case: If the field stays demonic, Trigon stays live.
x-factor.right_case: If the field becomes fuel, Galactus takes the fight back.
x-factor.implication: Whoever controls the battlefield's meaning controls the fight's branch logic.

interpretation.headline: INTERPRETATION
interpretation.subtitle: Who wins the fight on paper?
interpretation.body: Galactus owns the broader raw profile, but Trigon stays dangerous because his value is nonlinear and field-dependent. Neutral assumptions still favor Galactus.

fight-simulation.headline: FIGHT SIMULATION
fight-simulation.subtitle: The course of the fight across three phases.
fight-simulation.phase_1_body: Trigon tries to convert the first exchange into corruption, possession pressure, and anti-symmetry.
fight-simulation.phase_2_body: Galactus answers with scale stabilization, barrier control, and energy economy instead of respecting Trigon's preferred rules.
fight-simulation.phase_3_body: The finish depends on whether the battlefield stays toxic and demonic or gets normalized into something Galactus can metabolize.

stat-trap.headline: STAT TRAP
stat-trap.subtitle: Why better stats do not guarantee victory
stat-trap.question: Can Trigon keep the field poisonous before Galactus turns it into fuel?
stat-trap.body: Bigger averages do not erase domain logic. Galactus still keeps the baseline answer set, but this matchup changes sharply once the battlefield stops behaving like neutral space.

final-summary.headline: FINAL SUMMARY
final-summary.subtitle: Summary
final-summary.winner: Galactus leads, but Trigon has live branch equity
final-summary.line_1: Galactus owns the paper comparison, 92.67 vs 87.33.
final-summary.line_2: Trigon stays dangerous when corruption and field logic replace normal combat symmetry.
final-summary.line_3: Starvation and home-realm control are the two conditions that let Trigon flip the matchup.
